title: Identity Development
learningGoal: Help parents understand how children form identity and how to support confidence, belonging, and self-worth.
microLesson: Identity develops through relationships, culture, experiences, and the messages children receive about themselves. When parents provide acceptance, encouragement, and opportunities for self-expression, children build a strong sense of who they are. Criticism, comparison, or inconsistency can weaken identity formation. Parents play a key role in helping children feel valued and capable.
activity: Ask your child to share something they feel proud of. Reflect on how you responded and how it supported their identity.
